metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Date'[Year-Month],
			'Date'[Year-Month number],
			'Incidents'[Category],
			"Incident_count", '_Measures'[Incident count]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			201,
			SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Date'[Year-Month], 'Date'[Year-Month number]),
			'Date'[Year-Month number],
			1,
			'Date'[Year-Month],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Incidents'[Category])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(62, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'Incidents'[Category], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'Incidents'[Category],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'Incidents'[Category]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'Date'[Year-Month number], 'Date'[Year-Month], [ColumnIndex]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Incidents'[Entry origin kind], "Incident_count", '_Measures'[Incident count])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Incident_count], 0, 'Incidents'[Entry origin kind], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Incident_count] DESC, 'Incidents'[Entry origin kind]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Agent'[Agent],
			"Incident_count", '_Measures'[Incident count],
			"Incidents_by_entry_agent", '_Measures'[Incidents by entry agent]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Incident_count], 0, 'Agent'[Agent], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Incident_count] DESC, 'Agent'[Agent]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Agent'[Agent], "Influenced_share", '_Measures'[Influenced share])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Influenced_share], 0, 'Agent'[Agent], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Influenced_share] DESC, 'Agent'[Agent]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Block_rate", '_Measures'[Block rate],
		"Would_block_rate", '_Measures'[Would-block rate],
		"Incident_rate", '_Measures'[Incident rate],
		"Influenced_share", '_Measures'[Influenced share],
		"Block_rate_MoM_pp", '_Measures'[Block rate MoM pp],
		"Incident_rate_MoM_pp", '_Measures'[Incident rate MoM pp]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Guard'[Guard], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal", 'Guard'[Rule], "IsDM1Total"),
			"Would_blocks", '_Measures'[Would blocks],
			"Blocks", '_Measures'[Blocks],
			"Would_block_rate", '_Measures'[Would-block rate]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreTableByDM1 = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsDM1Total] = TRUE)),
			"IsGrandTotalRowTotal", [IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			"'Guard'[Guard]", 'Guard'[Guard],
			"SortBy_DM1_0", [Would_blocks]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0Core,
			__DS0CoreTableByDM1
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			[SortBy_DM1_0],
			0,
			'Guard'[Guard],
			1,
			[IsDM1Total],
			0,
			[Would_blocks],
			0,
			'Guard'[Rule],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals = 
		FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), AND([IsGrandTotalRowTotal] = FALSE, [IsDM1Total] = FALSE))

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals,
		"MinWould_blocks", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Would_blocks]),
		"MaxWould_blocks", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Would_blocks])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	[SortBy_DM1_0] DESC,
	'Guard'[Guard],
	[IsDM1Total] DESC,
	[Would_blocks] DESC,
	'Guard'[Rule]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"MinDate2", CALCULATE(MIN('Date'[Date])),
		"MaxDate2", CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[Date]))
	)
